summary: Learn how to create a customer-centric culture in your organization. Join our training course to learn actionable strategies for lasting impact.
lede: Customer-centricity training helps customer experience and service professionals turn customer feedback into decisions about journeys and service behavior. It covers interpreting Voice of Customer data, mapping end-to-end journeys, setting observable service behaviors, and assigning accountability for customer outcomes. Participants practice developing scorecards, service blueprints, and a culture roadmap to connect customer evidence, employee actions, and operational priorities.
audienceIntro: This customer-centric culture course is designed for professionals who influence customer journeys, service behavior, employee alignment, or customer experience governance.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in customer experience, service operations, organizational development, employee experience, transformation, or a related function. Familiarity with customer feedback, service metrics, or process mapping will help you engage with the intermediate-to-advanced workshops. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software, while anonymized organizational examples remain optional.
